clues.explain: 'Out' says the letters of NIGHT are out of order: rearrange them to get THING, an object.
'Shattered' breaks EARTH into pieces. Put them back as HEART, which is vital to life.
'Mishandled' tells you to rearrange SERPENT. It becomes PRESENT, a gift.
'Anew' means arrange LISTEN in a new way: SILENT, meaning quiet.
'To reform' is to form again: the letters of CHEAT re-form as TEACH, to instruct.
'Converted' changes DIRTY ROOM: its nine letters rearrange to DORMITORY, a place to sleep.
'Squashed' crushes LEMON out of shape. The letters make MELON, another fruit.
'Cut up' chops ROSE into letters to rearrange: SORE, meaning aching.
'In new form' asks for a new arrangement of RECAST: CRATES, which are boxes.
'Drawn badly' means A LINE is in the wrong order. Rearranged, it is ALIEN, a stranger.
'In' says the answer sits inside the next words: sLY REcital hides LYRE, an old instrument.
'Some of' means part of the letters: tHE ARticle contains HEAR, to listen to.
The letters are used by the next two words: greaT INventor holds TIN, a metal.
Look inside the words after 'in': granD ONE-liner hides DONE, meaning finished.
'Part of' points at a stretch of letters: tOP ERAs gives OPERA, a musical work.
'Featured in' says the answer appears inside: mAP PLEntifully contains APPLE, a fruit.
'Some' means some of the letters: hIDE Away hides IDEA, a notion.
'Kept in … enclosure' says the cat is enclosed by the letters: anTI-GERm holds TIGER.
'Backwards' reverses LIVE: EVIL, meaning wicked.
'Set back' turns TRAP around: PART, a portion.
'Knocked over' flips POTS end to end: STOP, to halt.
A retreat goes backwards: WARD reversed is DRAW, to sketch.
'Pulled back' reverses DRAWER: REWARD, a prize.
'Sent back' reverses DESSERTS: STRESSED, under pressure.
A sailor is a TAR and street is ST. TAR goes in ST: S(TAR)T, to begin.
The pet is a CAT, and the man is HE. CAT holding HE: C(HE)AT, a swindler.
A factory is a PLANT and energy is E. PLANT takes in E: PLAN(E)T, a world.
An artist is RA (Royal Academician) and a container is a BIN. RA in BIN: B(RA)IN, a clever person.
Exercise is PE and a wagon is a CART. PE in CART: CAR(PE)T, a floor covering.
Closed is SHUT and a ring is the letter O. SHUT around O: SH(O)UT, to cry out.
Ocean is SEA and boy is SON. Side by side they make SEASON, a time of year.
A vehicle is a CAR and a heavy weight is a TON. CAR + TON = CARTON, a box.
A child is a KID and a sleep is a NAP. KID + NAP = KIDNAP, to snatch.
A sailor is a TAR and to obtain is to GET. TAR + GET = TARGET, an aim.
A fellow is a MAN and to grow old is to AGE. MAN + AGE = MANAGE, to cope.
To pay (the bill) is to FOOT it, and a dance is a BALL. FOOT + BALL = FOOTBALL, a game.
A piece is a PART and a hilltop is a RIDGE. PART + RIDGE = PARTRIDGE, a bird.
'Starts to' asks for the first letter of each word: See Every Ancient Ship gives SEAS, oceans.
'Heads of' means first letters: Department Often Overlook Routine gives DOOR, an entrance.
'Oddly' takes the odd letters (1st, 3rd, 5th) of ANTLER: A-T-E. ATE means had dinner.
Take the odd characters of THE ANT (1st, 3rd, 5th): T-E-N. TEN is a number.
'Ends of' asks for the last letter of each word: coaT, onE, sofA, chaiR gives TEAR, to rip.
A world is a PLANET. 'Without tail' removes its last letter, leaving PLANE, which means level or flat.
A corridor is a HALL. Its 'head' is the first letter: HALL without H is ALL, everyone.
A lion's cry is a ROAR. 'Missing opening' drops its first letter, leaving OAR, a rowing blade.
Two definitions of one word: a ROSE is a flower, and ROSE also means got up.
Two meanings of JUST: fair (a just decision) and only (just one).
Two meanings of WELL: a spring of water, and in good health.
Two meanings of PORT: the left side of a ship, and a harbour.
Two meanings of TYPE: a kind or sort, and printed letters.
'We hear' means it sounds like something. A fruit, PEAR, sounds like PAIR, a couple.
'Reportedly' means when spoken. A pit is a HOLE, which sounds like WHOLE, entire.
'They say' means it's spoken. Not day is NIGHT, which sounds like KNIGHT, an armoured rider.
'On the radio' means heard, not seen. Ground grain is FLOUR, which sounds like FLOWER, a bloom.
